description: The time between two times in hours and minutes, and durations added up and subtracted. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

durations.description: Durations to add up instead, each optionally signed: ["1h 45m", "2:30", "-20 min"]. Accepts "1:45" (hours:minutes), "1:45:30", "1h 45m", "1.75h", "105 min", "2 hours 30 minutes", "90s". A bare number is minutes. When sent, the sum is returned; start/end are measured as well only if also sent.

end.description: End time of day, same formats as start. Without an endDate, an end earlier than the start is taken as the next day (22:00 to 06:00 is 8 hours) and `nextDay` is true.

endDate.description: Optional date of the end, YYYY-MM-DD. With both dates, an end before the start gives `backward: true`.

start.description: Start time of day: "09:00", "9:15:30", "9:15 am", "9pm", "0900" or "9h15". 24-hour or 12-hour with am/pm; seconds optional.

startDate.description: Optional date of the start, YYYY-MM-DD. If only one of startDate/endDate is sent, the other is worked out.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone such as "Europe/Copenhagen" or "America/New_York". With a date, both moments are placed in that zone, so a daylight-saving change in between is counted (`basis: "elapsed"`). Without it, or without dates, the answer is the wall-clock difference (`basis: "wall-clock"`).
